extName.description: Add-on name (manifest, popup and onboarding heading).

extDescription.message: Shows whether Steam games are playable on NVIDIA GeForce NOW.

bannerSupported.description: Store page banner: the game streams on GeForce NOW.

bannerNotSupported.description: Store page banner: the game is not in the GeForce NOW catalog.

bannerUnknown.description: Store page banner: the catalog could not be fetched.

bannerNeedsPermission.message: GeForce NOW: couldn't check — the toolbar icon may help
bannerNeedsPermission.description: Store page banner: fetch failed and the optional catalog grant is missing; suggests the toolbar icon.

pillNotSupported.description: Wishlist/games-list pill: not in the catalog.

launchPlayOn.description: Launch button label, followed by the GeForce NOW logo panel.

launchPlayOnTitle.message: Launch in the GeForce NOW app
launchPlayOnTitle.description: Tooltip of the app launch button.

launchPlayWeb.description: Launch button label: open the web app.

launchPlayWebTitle.message: Open in the GeForce NOW web app (new tab)
launchPlayWebTitle.description: Tooltip of the web launch button.

popupCheckingPermission.description: Popup status placeholder while permissions load.

popupStatusClickToRun.description: Popup status: Firefox runs the add-on only when the toolbar icon is clicked.

popupExplainClickToRun.message: Badges appear only after you click this icon — which is why the page behind this popup has one now.

popupExplainDirect.message: Badges appear on Steam store, wishlist and profile games pages. The catalog is read directly from NVIDIA.
popupExplainDirect.description: Popup explanation with the optional catalog grant held.

popupExplainOptional.message: Badges appear on Steam store, wishlist and profile games pages. Optionally, allow direct access to NVIDIA's catalog — not required today, but it keeps checks working if NVIDIA changes how the catalog may be read.
popupExplainOptional.description: Popup explanation without the optional catalog grant.

popupAllowSteam.description: Popup button: grant standing access to Steam pages.

popupAllowFeed.description: Popup/onboarding button: grant direct catalog access.

popupFetching.description: Popup catalog line while a refresh runs.

popupStillClickToRun.message: Still click-to-run. You can also allow it from the Add-ons Manager, under this add-on's Permissions.
popupStillClickToRun.description: Popup: the Steam access request was declined.

popupSteamGranted.message: Done — badges now appear on their own. Reload any Steam pages you already have open.
popupSteamGranted.description: Popup: the Steam access request succeeded.

popupNoBackground.message: Couldn't reach the extension's background service.
popupNoBackground.description: Popup: no reply from the background service.

popupCatalogLine.description: Popup catalog line. $COUNT$ = number of indexed Steam games, $AGE$ = relative time such as '3 h ago'.

popupRefreshFailedNoCatalog.message: Refresh failed — no catalog cached yet.
popupRefreshFailedNoCatalog.description: Popup: refresh failed and nothing was cached before.

popupRefreshFailedSuffix.description: Appended to the catalog line when a refresh failed but the old catalog remains. Keep the leading separator.

onboardingTitle.message: Welcome — GeForce NOW check for Steam

onboardingSub.message: You're all set — here's what it does.

onboardingIntro.message: Open any Steam game page, your wishlist or your profile's games list and you'll see whether the game streams on NVIDIA GeForce NOW: a green marker when it does, a neutral one when it doesn't. Availability comes from NVIDIA's public catalog, cached locally and refreshed every 12 hours.
onboardingIntro.description: Onboarding paragraph explaining what the add-on does.

onboardingReady.message: Ready — open a Steam game page to see GeForce NOW badges.
onboardingReady.description: Onboarding status: standing Steam access held.

onboardingClickToRun.message: Set to run only when you click the toolbar icon. Badges still work; you'll just click the icon on each page. The popup can switch this to automatic.

onboardingOptional.message: Optional: you can allow the add-on to read NVIDIA's catalog directly. It isn't needed today — checks work without it — but it keeps them working if NVIDIA ever changes how the catalog may be read.
onboardingOptional.description: Onboarding: the optional catalog grant, explained.

ageDaysOne.description: Relative age in days, plural category 'one'. $N$ = number.

ageDaysFew.description: Relative age in days, plural category 'few'. $N$ = number.

ageDaysMany.description: Relative age in days, plural category 'many'. $N$ = number.

ageDaysOther.description: Relative age in days, plural category 'other'. $N$ = number.
